description: A small board that lights a red LED from a 5 V supply on a 2-pin header, with a current-limiting resistor for about 10 mA. Name the supply nets VCC and GND.
12 V to 5 V regulator board for up to 100 mA using a 78xx-style linear regulator, with input and output 2-pin headers and a green power LED on the output. Name the nets VIN, +5V and GND.
Two LEDs that blink alternately at about 1 Hz, driven by a 555 timer, powered from 5 V through a 2-pin header. Name the supply nets VCC and GND.
A USB-C receptacle that provides 5 V to a 2-pin output header. Include the 5.1k CC pull-down resistors so chargers supply 5 V, and a power LED. Name the nets VBUS, GND, CC1 and CC2.

Single-supply 5 V microphone preamp for an electret mic: mic bias resistor, op-amp non-inverting stage with a gain of about 100 at 1 kHz, mid-supply reference, AC-coupled input and output. Mic input, power and audio output on pin headers. Name the nets VCC, GND, MIC and AUDIO_OUT.
Breakout board for a BME280 temperature/humidity/pressure sensor on I2C, powered from 3.3 V, with 4.7k I2C pull-ups and a 4-pin header. Name the nets VCC, GND, SCL and SDA.
Push button with RC debouncing feeding a 74HC14 Schmitt-trigger inverter, 5 V supply, output on a 3-pin header. Name the nets VCC, GND and OUT.

Low-side N-channel MOSFET switch that lets a 3.3 V logic signal switch a 12 V, 1 A load, with gate resistor, gate pull-down, and a flyback diode for inductive loads. Headers or screw terminals for 12 V in, the load, and the logic input. The load connects between V12 and LOAD_NEG. Name the nets V12, GND, LOAD_NEG and CTRL.
ATtiny85 microcontroller board with a 6-pin ISP programming header, an LED on PB0, decoupling, and a 2-pin 5 V power header. Name the supply nets VCC and GND.

RS-485 transceiver breakout using a MAX485-compatible chip at 5 V, with a 120 ohm termination resistor, and headers for the UART side (RO, DI, DE/RE, VCC, GND) and the bus side (A, B, GND). Name the bus nets A and B, and the supply nets VCC and GND.
Passive first-order RC low-pass filter with a 1 kHz cutoff, input and output on 2-pin headers. Name the nets IN, OUT and GND.

A 2.5 V reference made from a resistor divider on a 5 V supply, buffered by an op-amp voltage follower so it can drive a 1k load. Power and the reference output on pin headers. Name the nets VCC, GND and VREF_OUT.
